sentences.review: 'Whose book is this?' hides the dative + gehören structure the sentence is meant to teach and turns 'das Buch' into 'this'; suggest 'Who does the book belong to? / Whose is the book?' (the same applies to the concept example).

sentences.en: Who did you tell that to?

sentences.text: Bei wem bist du heute Abend?
sentences.en: Whose place are you at tonight?

sentences.text: Ich weiß nicht, wem das gehört.
sentences.en: I don't know who this belongs to.

sentences.text: Weißt du, mit wem sie gesprochen hat?
sentences.en: Do you know who she talked to?

sentences.text: Wem hat Ali das Geld gegeben?
sentences.en: Who did Ali give the money to?
